role.en: Call in Engineers to construct and Repair Structures. Engineers can be equipped with Minesweepers, Flamethrowers, Wire Cutters and Demolition Charges.

desc.en: Primary Builder. Good vs. Buildings.
desc.es: Constructor principal. Bueno contra edificios.

desc.en: Equip Engineers with the M2 Flamethrower.

desc.en: Equip Engineers with the SCR-625 Mine detector to clear mines.

desc.en: Repair a Structure or Vehicle for a nominal Resource cost.

role.en: The SdKfz 221 Scout Car has great speed and mobility. Armed with an MG42 light machine gun, the Scout car can engage light targets and also capture and hold territory.

desc.en: Good vs. Snipers, can capture Territory

role.en: The Jagdpanther is a heavy tank destroyer mating the 88mm Pak 43 from King Tiger to a turretless Panther Tank chassis.  It boasts a powerful engine giving it a good power-to-weight ratio resulting in good mobility on the battlefield.
role.es: El Jagdpanther es un destructor de tanques pesado que combina la Pak 43 de 88 mm del King Tiger con el chasis de un tanque Panther sin torreta.  Presume de un potente motor que le proporciona una buena relación potencia-peso, lo que supone una gran movilidad en el campo de batalla.

desc.en: Good vs. Tanks.
desc.es: Bueno contra tanques.
